column1: # D-057 AVAILABILITY-TIME JOIN TABLE — the publication lag of every context series the sheets carry.

# Built 2026-08-13 by the P-M2a lane from the per-subdir MANIFEST.tsv publication_lag fields (manifest_source names the exact file), DATA_INVENTORY.md §3/§4b and D-057 itself. Referenced from DATA_INVENTORY.md §4c.

# LAW (D-057 / PORT_M2_SHEETS_SPEC.md §2): a series joins on availability_ts = f(stamp_date), never on its stamp date. The sheet builder's guard enforces availability_ts < decision_ts (strict; the pinned reading of "availability_ts <= decision_ts, never equal-time", see engine/port_m2/m2_common.py CausalGuard.avail).
# avail_rule vocabulary (implemented in engine/port_m2/availability.py, one function per rule, red-first fixtures in engine/port_m2/leakfix.py):

#   NEXT_US_BD        00:00 America/New_York of the first US business day STRICTLY AFTER stamp_date. US business days are read from the data: the observation dates of FRED_DGS10.csv carrying a numeric value (Treasury publication days).
#   H10_NEXT_MONDAY   16:15 America/New_York of the first Monday STRICTLY AFTER stamp_date (Fed H.10 weekly release covering through the prior Friday).
#   COT_FRI_1530ET    15:30 America/New_York of (stamp_date + 3 days) — the CFTC Friday release of the Tuesday-stamped report.
#   NEXT_JST_BD_1500  15:00 Asia/Tokyo of the first JGB business day STRICTLY AFTER stamp_date ("next JST afternoon", D-057). JST business days are read from JGB_yields_all.csv observation dates.
#   NEXT_JST_BD_0000  00:00 Asia/Tokyo of the first JST business day STRICTLY AFTER stamp_date.

#   NEXT_CN_BD_0000   00:00 Asia/Shanghai of the first Mon-Fri weekday STRICTLY AFTER stamp_date (no long CN daily calendar is banked; the weekday rule is conservative for a Friday-stamped weekly series).

#   SCHEDULE_EXEMPT   no lag arithmetic — the dates are announced months ahead (D-057 exempts scheduled calendars). The EVENT fires at its own scheduled clock; the sheet shows only the NEXT release strictly after decision_ts plus a countdown.
# UNKNOWN LAG DEFAULT (D-057): NEXT_US_BD for US-published series, NEXT_JST_BD_0000 for JP, NEXT_CN_BD_0000 for CN. Every row below states which rule it uses and why; no row is defaulted silently.
